dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to know a great deal.

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: Honestly, it's not much. I've loved history since I was little, and I've always wanted to see these ruins in person. That's why I became an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: Well... these are some records I've made of my adventures. You can have them.

dialogues.speaker: Wenze
dialogues.text: Nothing would make me happier than to help someone else with my knowledge!
